text:
maria-support: Customer reports sudden SSO 403s after their IdP rotated certs. They say nothing changed on the SP side.

maria-support: Quick error from our auth svc:

ERROR saml.verify: recipient mismatch expected="https://app.customer.example.com/sso/acs" got="https://app.customer.example.com/sso/acs%3Ftoken%3Dxyz" status=403 tenant=acme-corp

maria-support: Redacted Assertion snippet:

<saml:SubjectConfirmationData Recipient="https://app.customer.example.com/sso/acs%3Ftoken%3Dxyz" NotOnOrAfter="..."/>

devon-idp: can you attach the saml Response (redacted) and the IdP metadata URL? Also when did the IdP rotate?

maria-support: IdP rotation at ~2024-10-12T08:12:00Z. Metadata: https://idp.acme.example/.well-known/saml.xml

supportbot: checklist: verify metadata reachable, check KeyDescriptor order, check cert chain, check CDN/cache headers, check proxies rewriting querystrings.

ida-infra: any appliance/cdn in front of the ACS? If so purge edges. Proxies sometimes url-encode downstream hrefs which can end up in Recipient.

maria-support: Customer confirmed they have an inline proxy that appends token as query param to ACS for routing. Looks like IdP sent the Recipient with encoded query param.

eng-runtime: I reproduced by generating a Response with Recipient percent-encoded. Our recipient comparison is exact string equality against the configured ACS (no percent-decoding or canonicalization).

eng-runtime: Also noticed their IdP metadata included only the new leaf certificate (no intermediate). Our metadata poller cached the previous key order and didn't immediately surface the incomplete chain as an error.

devon-idp: Okta side: they rotated keys and their published metadata changed key order. Some IdP responses included the encoded ACS; best practice is to use RelayState for nonces instead of putting query params in Recipient.

maria-support: Customer tried forcing a metadata refresh in our Console and also uploaded new metadata manually. Partial recovery: some users still got 403 intermittently.

ida-infra: intermittent 403s = some edges still using old cached metadata or old cert. Purge CDN + invalidate metadata cache regionally.

eng-runtime: immediate workaround we recommend to customer: (1) add the encoded-acs variant as an allowed ACS alias in tenant SSO config; (2) force metadata refresh on the tenant in Console; (3) purge CDN caches.

maria-support: customer accepted adding ACS alias and did a manual refresh. Reported ~90% success immediately.

eng-runtime: medium-term engineering fixes:
- make recipient check tolerant of percent-encoding differences (canonicalize and compare)
- metadata poller to validate full chain and trigger an aggressive re-fetch or alert if intermediates are missing
- expose tenant-friendly UI to add ACS aliases quickly

eng-runtime: low-risk patch ready. Planning canary at 22:00 UTC tonight. Will watch per-tenant 403 rates and "recipient mismatch" logs.

samops: tracking metrics and will alert if regressions. post PR when available.

eng-runtime: PR: https://git.company/infra/eng-runtime/pulls/2491 includes canonicalization and poller improvements.

ida-infra: after patch roll we'll do a cross-region cache purge.

maria-support: I'll update the customer that a canary + cache purge is planned tonight and that we've applied a temporary ACS alias. Will coordinate a maintenance window.

devon-idp: I'll also reach out to the IdP admin to recommend publishing full cert chain and moving nonce to RelayState.

eng-runtime: post-canary note: canary reduced recipient-mismatch errors for the tenant from 60/min to ~1/min. Rolling to 50% now.

maria-support: final update: 100% roll, full CDN purge, customer confirms sign-ins recovered. We'll keep ticket open for 24h to confirm stability. :white_check_mark:

supportbot: incident timeline entry:
- 08:12 UTC IdP key rotation
- 08:18 UTC customer reports 403s
- 08:29 UTC found encoded query param in Recipient
- 08:45 UTC manual metadata upload + alias applied -> partial recovery
- 22:00 UTC canary deploy recipient-canonicalization patch
- 22:40 UTC roll to prod and cross-region cache purge
- resolution: customer verified after purge
